title: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon
reason: Third-party listing of the 2026 event: $1M prize pool, indie and startup tracks, 20,000 applicant cap, submission due 5 Nov 2026 6:30 AM IST, no judging rubric; page shows no publish date.

title: Meta plant globalen KI Hackathon fuer Entwickler
reason: German news at announcement: 10 days, fully virtual, $1M pool, $150 API credit each; tracks and official criteria not yet published, so its seven judging dimensions are the author's suggestions only.

title: Meta Model API
reason: Meta's official product page (redirects to dev.meta.ai): lists Muse Spark 1.1 to 1.3 with contributor variants, self-serve access, and Muse Image and SAM 3.1; no date shown.

title: Meta Model API
reason: Official docs: muse-spark-1.3 is the recommended default; all Muse Spark versions take text, image, video, audio and PDF input; tool calling and structured output listed; Standard mode excludes training, Contributor mode may be used for training.

title: Meta Model API
reason: Third-party integration docs: base URL https://api.meta.ai/v1, muse-spark-1.1 supports function calling, image and PDF input, structured outputs and web search; corroborates the official docs but is not Meta's.

title: Muse Spark Open: Meta open-weight license
reason: Muse Model License terms: internal and product use allowed, notice and separate agreement above $20M revenue for AI services, required 'Built with Muse Spark Open' label, and an acceptable-use policy banning weapons, malware, fraud and impersonation.

title: Meta makes Muse Spark available as an open-weight model
reason: Confirms the weights fall under the proprietary Muse Model License with limited commercial terms, 816B total and 42B active parameters, and extra safety training; does not list usage-policy terms and does not call the release open source.
